questions.question: A, B and C are sections of Class X. The ratio of A : B is 9 : 4 and that of A : C is 3 : 2. Find A : B :C.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Make the common term (A) equal in both given ratios.

Given, A : B = 9 : 4 and A : C = 3 : 2

Multiply the ratio A : C by 3 → A : C = 9 : 6

Combined ratio → A : B : C = 9 : 4 : 6

Multiply all terms by 3 to match the given options → A : B : C = 27 : 12 : 18

**∴ The correct answer is 27 : 12 : 18.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of A : B = 9 : 4

Ratio of A : C = 3 : 2

 
 
 
 
 A
 B
 C
 
 27 (9 × 3)
 12 (4 × 3)
 18 (6 × 3)
 
 Equivalent Ratio Proportions
 A : B : C = 27 : 12 : 18

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let A = 9x, then B = 4x (from the ratio A : B = 9 : 4)

⇒ Substitute the value of A in the second ratio A : C = 3 : 2

⇒ 9x / C = 3 / 2

⇒ 3 × C = 18x

⇒ C = 6x

⇒ Now, write the combined ratio A : B : C.

⇒ A : B : C = 9x : 4x : 6x

⇒ A : B : C = 9 : 4 : 6

⇒ Multiply each term by 3 to find an equivalent ratio that matches the given options.

⇒ A : B : C = (9 × 3) : (4 × 3) : (6 × 3)

⇒ A : B : C = 27 : 12 : 18

**∴ The correct answer is 27 : 12 : 18.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Equivalent Ratios

Multiplying or dividing each term of a ratio by the same non-zero number produces an equivalent ratio without changing its core value (e.g., 9 : 4 : 6 is exactly equivalent to 27 : 12 : 18).

Compound Ratio

When two or more ratios are multiplied together, it is known as a compound ratio. For a : b and c : d, the compound ratio is simply ac : bd.

Invertendo Property

If a : b = c : d, then by the property of invertendo, b : a = d : c. This is highly useful for rearranging common terms symmetrically to find combined proportional ratios.
</p

questions.question: If at same rate of interest, in 2 years, the simple interest is ₹42 and compound interest is ₹45 , then what is the principal (in ₹)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Difference between CI and SI for 2 years = ₹45 − ₹42 = ₹3.

SI for 1 year = ₹42 ÷ 2 = ₹21.

Rate % = (Difference ÷ SI for 1 year) × 100 = (3 ÷ 21) × 100 = 100/7%.

Principal = (SI for 1 year × 100) ÷ Rate = (21 × 100) ÷ (100/7) = 21 × 7 = ₹147.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹147.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Simple Interest for 2 years = ₹42

Compound Interest for 2 years = ₹45

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 
 Principal (P)

 

 

 
 Year 1 SI
 ₹21

 
 Year 2 SI
 ₹21

 

 
 
 + ₹3

**Formula Used:**

SI for 1 year = Total SI ÷ Time

Difference between CI and SI for 2 years = CI − SI

Rate (R) = (Difference ÷ SI for 1st year) × 100

Principal (P) = (SI × 100) ÷ (R × T)

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI for 1 year = 42 ÷ 2 = ₹21

⇒ Difference between CI and SI for 2 years = 45 − 42 = ₹3

⇒ The difference is the additional interest earned on the 1st year's SI.

⇒ Rate of Interest (R) = (3 ÷ 21) × 100 = 100/7%

⇒ Principal (P) = (SI for 1 year × 100) ÷ R

⇒ P = (21 × 100) ÷ (100/7)

⇒ P = 21 × 7 = ₹147

**∴ The correct answer is ₹147.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Difference between CI and SI for 2 years

For a given principal P and rate R, the difference for 2 years is calculated as: CI − SI = P(R/100)².

First Year Interest Property

For the first year, simple interest and compound interest are exactly the same when compounded annually. The difference arises in the second year due to interest calculated on the first year's interest.

Rate Determination Shortcut

When both CI and SI for 2 years are given, the rate can be directly found as: Rate = [2 × (CI − SI) ÷ SI] × 100.

questions.question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2000 at 6.75% per annum rate of interest for the period from 3 February 2023 to 17 April 2023.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total time from 3 Feb to 17 Apr = 25 days (Feb) + 31 days (Mar) + 17 days (Apr) = 73 days.

Time (T) in years = 73 ÷ 365 = 1/5 years.

Using the Direct Simple Interest formula: SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = (2000 × 6.75 × 1/5) ÷ 100 = 20 × 1.35 = 27

**∴ The correct answer is ₹27.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2000

Rate of Interest (R) = 6.75% per annum

Time Period = 3 February 2023 to 17 April 2023

 
• 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 3 Feb
 (25 days)

 March
 (31 days)

 17 Apr
 (17 days)

 

 
 Total = 73 days
 
 
 P = ₹2000 | R = 6.75% | T = 73/365 y

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculations:**

⇒ Number of days in February 2023 (a non-leap year) = 28

⇒ Remaining days in February = 28 − 3 = 25 days

⇒ Days in March = 31 days

⇒ Days in April = 17 days

⇒ Total Time (T) in days = 25 + 31 + 17 = 73 days

⇒ Time (T) in years = 73 ÷ 365 = 1/5 years

⇒ SI = [2000 × 6.75 × (1/5)] ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 20 × 6.75 × (1/5)

⇒ SI = 4 × 6.75

⇒ SI = 27

**∴ The correct answer is ₹27.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Rule for Counting Days in SI

When calculating simple interest between two exact dates, either the starting day or the ending day is included, but never both. Most commonly, the starting date is excluded and the end date is included.

Leap Year Identification

A year is a leap year if it is perfectly divisible by 4. However, century years must be divisible by 400. In non-leap years (like 2023), February has exactly 28 days.

Common Days to Years Conversions

Standard fractional year conversions used frequently in exams: 73 days = 1/5 year, 146 days = 2/5 year, 219 days = 3/5 year, and 292 days = 4/5 year.

questions.question: The capacity of a cuboidal tank of water is 62000 litres. Find the breadth of the tank, if its length and depth are 2.5 m and 10 m, respectively.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume in m³ = Capacity in litres ÷ 1000 = 62000 ÷ 1000 = 62 m³

Breadth = Volume ÷ (Length × Depth)

Breadth = 62 ÷ (2.5 × 10)

Breadth = 62 ÷ 25 = 2.48 m

**∴ The correct answer is 2.48 m.**

Capacity of the tank = 62000 litres

Length (L) = 2.5 m

Depth (D) = 10 m

**Formula Used:**

1 m³ = 1000 litres

Volume of cuboid = Length × Breadth × Depth

questions.question: In an experiment, the refractive index of water was found to be 1.35, 1.29, 1.32 and 1.36. What is the average refractive index of water?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the assumed average be 1.30.

Deviations of the given values (1.35, 1.29, 1.32, 1.36) from 1.30 are: +0.05, −0.01, +0.02, +0.06.

Net deviation = 0.05 − 0.01 + 0.02 + 0.06 = +0.12

Average deviation = +0.12 ÷ 4 = +0.03

Actual average = Assumed average + Average deviation = 1.30 + 0.03 = 1.33

**∴ The correct answer is 1.33.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Values of refractive index of water = 1.35, 1.29, 1.32, 1.36

Number of observations = 4

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of all observations ÷ Total number of observations

 
• 
 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 

 
 1.29
 
 
 1.32
 
 
 1.35
 
 
 1.36

 
• 
 

 
 Mean = 1.33
 Average = 1.33

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of given values = 1.35 + 1.29 + 1.32 + 1.36

⇒ Sum = 5.32

⇒ Average = 5.32 ÷ 4

⇒ Average = 1.33

**∴ The correct answer is 1.33.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Deviation Method for Averages

If an assumed mean A is taken, the actual mean = A + (Sum of deviations ÷ Total number of items). This drastically reduces calculation effort for closely grouped numbers.

Combined Average

If group 1 has n₁ items with average A₁ and group 2 has n₂ items with average A₂, the combined average is calculated as: (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Refractive Index Context

The refractive index (n) is a dimensionless number describing how fast light travels through a material. It is calculated as the ratio of the speed of light in vacuum to the speed of light in the medium (n = c ÷ v). The standard refractive index of water is approximately 1.33.
</p

Relative speed (same direction) = 110 − 80 = 30 km/h = 30 × 5/18 = 25/3 m/s

questions.question: 400 apples were bought at ₹1240 per hundred and were sold at a profit of ₹840. Find the selling price (in ₹) per dozen of apples.

Total CP for 400 apples = 4 × 1240 = ₹4960

Total SP = CP + Profit = 4960 + 840 = ₹5800

Cost price of 100 apples = ₹1240

questions.question: A can complete a task in 16 days, and B can complete the same task in 24 days. If A and B work on alternate days starting with A, in how many days will the task be completed?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM(16, 24) = 48 units.

Efficiency of A = 3 units/day, Efficiency of B = 2 units/day.

Work done in 2 days (A then B) = 3 + 2 = 5 units.

In 18 days (9 cycles), work done = 9 × 5 = 45 units.

Remaining 3 units are completed by A on the 19th day (3 ÷ 3 = 1 day).

**∴ The correct answer is 19 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by A = 16 days

Time taken by B = 24 days

They work on alternate days starting with A.

**Method Used:**

Total Work = LCM of given days. Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Days.

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 A
 16
 48
 3
 
 

 B
 24
 2
 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Work done in the first 2 days (1 cycle) = 3 (by A) + 2 (by B) = 5 units

⇒ Multiplier to get close to total work: 48 ÷ 5 = 9 cycles with a remainder

⇒ Work done in 9 cycles (18 days) = 9 × 5 = 45 units

⇒ Remaining work = 48 − 45 = 3 units

⇒ On the 19th day, it is A's turn.

⇒ Time taken by A to complete remaining 3 units = 3 ÷ 3 = 1 day

⇒ Total time taken = 18 days + 1 day = 19 days

**∴ The correct answer is 19 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Alternate Days Concept

When individuals work on alternate days, calculate the combined work for one full cycle (equal to the number of people). Never divide the total work directly by combined efficiency.

Efficiency vs Time

Efficiency is inversely proportional to time. If A and B take time in the ratio x:y, their working efficiencies will be in the ratio y:x.

Work and Wages

If multiple people complete a piece of work together, the total wages are distributed in the ratio of the total work done by each person.
</p

questions.question: LCM and HCF of two numbers are 54 and 9 respectively. If one of the numbers is 18, then find the other number.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Second Number = (LCM × HCF) ÷ First Number

⇒ Second Number = (54 × 9) ÷ 18

⇒ Second Number = 3 × 9 = 27

**∴ The correct answer is 27.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

LCM of the two numbers = 54

HCF of the two numbers = 9

One of the numbers = 18

**Formula Used:**

Product of two numbers = LCM × HCF

**Calculations:**

⇒ First Number × Second Number = LCM × HCF

⇒ 18 × Second Number = 54 × 9

⇒ 18 × Second Number = 486

⇒ Second Number = 486 ÷ 18

⇒ Second Number = 27

**∴ The correct answer is 27.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Product of Numbers Rule

For any two positive integers a and b, the product of their HCF and LCM is strictly equal to the product of the numbers: a × b = HCF(a, b) × LCM(a, b).

Co-prime Numbers

Two numbers are co-prime if their highest common factor (HCF) is 1. The LCM of two co-prime numbers is always equal to their product.

HCF & LCM of Fractions

HCF = (HCF of Numerators) ÷ (LCM of Denominators)
LCM = (LCM of Numerators) ÷ (HCF of Denominators)
</p

questions.question: The LCM of 16, 45, 135 and 144 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The LCM must be exactly divisible by all the given numbers: 16, 45, 135, and 144.

Since 144 is a multiple of 9 (144 = 16 × 9), the LCM must also be a multiple of 9.

Checking the sum of digits of the given options for divisibility by 9:

Only 2160 has a digit sum of 9 (2 + 1 + 6 + 0 = 9), which means it is completely divisible by 9.

It also ends in a 0, satisfying the divisibility criteria for both 5 (from 45) and an even number (from 16).

**∴ The correct answer is 2160.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The numbers to find the LCM for are 16, 45, 135, and 144.

**Method Used: Prime Factorisation**

⇒ Prime factors of 16 = 2⁴

⇒ Prime factors of 45 = 3² × 5

⇒ Prime factors of 135 = 3³ × 5

⇒ Prime factors of 144 = 2⁴ × 3²

The LCM is evaluated by taking the product of the highest powers of all prime factors present in the numbers.

⇒ Highest power of 2 = 2⁴

⇒ Highest power of 3 = 3³

⇒ Highest power of 5 = 5¹

⇒ LCM = 2⁴ × 3³ × 5

⇒ LCM = 16 × 27 × 5

⇒ LCM = 16 × 135

⇒ LCM = 2160

**∴ The correct answer is 2160.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Least Common Multiple (LCM)

The smallest positive integer that is completely divisible by each of the given numbers. It is determined by taking the highest power of each unique prime factor involved.

Divisibility Rule of 9

A number is exactly divisible by 9 if the sum of all its digits is a multiple of 9. This simple trick is extremely useful for quickly eliminating options in complex LCM calculations.

Relation between HCF and LCM

For any two specific numbers a and b, their product is exactly equal to the product of their HCF and LCM. Formula: a × b = HCF(a, b) × LCM(a, b). Note that this specific rule does not directly apply to three or more numbers.
</p

questions.question: Two numbers, m and n, are such that the sum of 4% of m and 6% of n is equal to half of the sum of 7% of m and 14% of n. Determine the ratio of m : n.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since the percentage sign (%) is common to all terms, cancel it directly to simplify the equation.

Directly write the mathematical expression: 4m + 6n = (7m + 14n) ÷ 2

Cross multiply by 2: 8m + 12n = 7m + 14n

Group similar variables: 8m − 7m = 14n − 12n

m = 2n ⇒ m : n = 2 : 1

**∴ The correct answer is 2 : 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of 4% of m and 6% of n = 1/2 of the sum of 7% of m and 14% of n.

 Ratio Comparison of m and n
 
 m
 
 
• 
 1 part
 1 part
 2 units

 n
 
 1 part
 1 unit

 m : n = 2 : 1

**Calculation:**

⇒ (4 / 100) × m + (6 / 100) × n = (1 / 2) × [ (7 / 100) × m + (14 / 100) × n ]

⇒ (4m + 6n) / 100 = 1/2 × [ (7m + 14n) / 100 ]

⇒ Canceling 100 from the denominators on both sides:

⇒ 4m + 6n = (7m + 14n) / 2

⇒ 2 × (4m + 6n) = 7m + 14n

⇒ 8m + 12n = 7m + 14n

⇒ 8m − 7m = 14n − 12n

⇒ m = 2n

⇒ m / n = 2 / 1

⇒ m : n = 2 : 1

**∴ The correct answer is 2 : 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Proportion Rule

An equation stating that two ratios are equal (a : b = c : d) implies that ad = bc (Product of extremes = Product of means).

Compound Ratio

When two or more ratios are multiplied together, it forms a compound ratio. For a : b and c : d, the compound ratio is ac : bd.

Componendo and Dividendo

If a / b = c / d, then according to this algebraic identity, (a + b) / (a − b) = (c + d) / (c − d).

questions.question: Asha bought a mixer for ₹2,160 and sold it for ₹1,998. Find the loss percentage.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Cost Price to Selling Price = 2160 : 1998

Dividing both sides by 54, we get CP : SP = 40 : 37

Loss in ratio parts = 40 − 37 = 3 parts

Loss % = (Loss parts ÷ CP parts) × 100

Loss % = (3 ÷ 40) × 100 = 7.5%

**∴ The correct answer is 7.5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) of the mixer = ₹2160

Selling Price (SP) of the mixer = ₹1998

 
 Cost Price (CP) = ₹2160

 
 Selling Price (SP) = ₹1998

 
 Loss

 
• 
 
• 

 Loss % = (162 ÷ 2160) × 100 = 7.5%

**Formula Used:**

Loss = CP − SP

Loss % = (Loss ÷ CP) × 100

**Calculations:**

⇒ Loss = 2160 − 1998

⇒ Loss = ₹162

⇒ Loss % = (162 ÷ 2160) × 100

⇒ Loss % = 1620 ÷ 216

⇒ Loss % = 7.5%

**∴ The correct answer is 7.5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Base of Calculation

Profit and Loss percentages are always calculated on the Cost Price (CP) unless specifically stated otherwise in the question.

Marked Price & Discount

Discount is always offered on the Marked Price (MP). The fundamental relationship is given by: SP = MP − Discount.

Dishonest Dealer

When a dealer claims to sell at CP but uses a false weight, his actual CP is based on the false weight given, while SP is based on the claimed weight.

questions.question: Four runners started running simultaneously from a point on a circular track. They took 280 seconds, 350 seconds, 420 seconds and 560 seconds, respectively, to complete one round. After how much time (in seconds) do they meet at the starting point for the first time?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To find when multiple runners meet at the starting point for the first time, simply calculate the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of their individual lap times.

Required Time = LCM(280, 350, 420, 560)

We can factor out the common divisor 70 to make it easier:

Required Time = 70 × LCM(4, 5, 6, 8)

The LCM of 4, 5, 6, and 8 is 120.

Required Time = 70 × 120 = 8400 seconds.

**∴ The correct answer is 8400 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by Runner 1 (T₁) = 280 s

Time taken by Runner 2 (T₂) = 350 s

Time taken by Runner 3 (T₃) = 420 s

Time taken by Runner 4 (T₄) = 560 s

questions.question: The price (per litre) of petrol increases by 70%. By what percent should its consumption be reduced such that the expenditure on it increases by 19% only?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the base value for price, consumption and expenditure be 100.

New Price = 100 + 70 = 170

New Expenditure = 100 + 19 = 119

Reduction in consumption % = [(New Price − New Expenditure) ÷ New Price] × 100

⇒ [(170 − 119) ÷ 170] × 100 = (51 ÷ 170) × 100 = 30%

**∴ The correct answer is 30%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

questions.question: The marked price of an electronic watch in a store is ₹25,960, and it is available at a discount of 20%. What is the price (in ₹) that a customer pays if he buys it from the store?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Selling Price (SP) = Marked Price × (100% − Discount%)

SP = 25960 × (100% − 20%)

SP = 25960 × 80%

SP = 25960 × 4/5 = 5192 × 4

SP = 20768

**∴ The correct answer is ₹20,768.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price (MP) of the watch = ₹25,960

Discount offered = 20%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = MP − (Discount % of MP)

 
 Marked Price
 ₹25,960
 
 
 Selling Price
 ? (80%)

 

 

 -20% Discount

**Calculations:**

⇒ Discount Amount = 20% of 25960

⇒ Discount = (20 / 100) × 25960

⇒ Discount = 2 × 2596 = 5192

⇒ Selling Price = Marked Price − Discount Amount

⇒ SP = 25960 − 5192

⇒ SP = 20768

**∴ The correct answer is ₹20,768.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discounts

When two consecutive discounts of a% and b% are given, the equivalent single discount is given by the formula (a + b − ab/100)%.

Relation between CP, MP, and Discount

MP ÷ CP = (100 + Profit %) ÷ (100 − Discount %). This relationship is extremely useful when both profit percentage and discount percentage are known.

Profit/Loss Percentage Rule

Profit and Loss percentages are always calculated on the Cost Price (CP) unless stated otherwise, whereas Discount is strictly calculated on the Marked Price (MP).
